items.summary: CTO disposition: reject both new product proposals and all new admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, measurement backlog and failed requests remain unresolved, and no new queue, telemetry, research, prototype, spend, or production work is technically admissible. Preserve only existing canonical work. Complete or justifiably close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z with root-cause or closure evidence, deterministic tests, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback point, release/security boundaries, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Release one slot only after that evidence is recorded; then admit at most the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after site-overlap clearance. Keep SearchWoot private and leave rights outreach unsent.

Technical review confirms the proposed fleet work-admission and measurement-debt concepts are feasible as future read-only products, but neither should enter the queue now. They would add implementation and validation load without resolving the canonical repair or saturated capacity. Preserve them as unexecuted planning context; do not create telemetry, dependencies, permissions, schedules, or production changes.
